description: Release-readiness check for a shipped release: confirms the GitHub release exists, the npm package version is live, the MCP Registry record is active, and the GHCR image tag is published, returning a GO / NO-GO verdict per surface. Agent-callable surface of `greenlight shipcheck`.

mcp_name.description: MCP registry server name; defaults from server.json, then the API.

npm_package.description: npm package name; defaults from package.json, then the API.

version.description: Release version without the v prefix, e.g. 0.21.4.

name: shipcheck
